title: [Bug]: `GmailToolSpec.load_data()` applies `GmailToolSpec.search_messages()` without arguments
body:
### Bug Description

`GmailToolSpec.load_data()` applies `GmailToolSpec.search_messages()` without arguments:
```
  def load_data(self) -> List[Document]:
      """Load emails from the user's account."""
      self._cache_service()

      return self.search_messages()
```
### Version

latest

### Steps to Reproduce

```
from llama_hub.tools.gmail.base import GmailToolSpec

tool_spec = GmailToolSpec()

agent = OpenAIAgent.from_tools(tool_spec.to_tool_list())
agent.chat("...")
```

### Relevant Logs/Tracbacks

```shell
in `load_data() `search_messages()` missing 1 required positional argument: 'query'
```

linked_prs.title: Fix: GmailToolSpec.load_data() applies GmailTool...#18414
linked_prs.body:
# Description

Fixes #18414 GmailToolSpec.load_data() applies GmailToolSpec.search_messages() without arguments.

GmailToolSpec.load_data() calls GmailToolSpec.search_messages() without any parameters when the Agent is asked to query for emails without any filters

```
def load_data(self) -> List[Document]:
      """Load emails from the user's account."""
      self._cache_service()

      return self.search_messages()
```

The change allows the agent to pass in an empty query to the gmail client, which in turn returns the last `max_results` number of emails.
